up: Retrieve the distinct molecule records (including their internal identifier molregno and the document identifier chembl_id) that are associated with the document CHEMBL5727678, along with their associated compound name and the document title. This requires selecting all molecule entries linked to the specified document ID in the activities table, ensuring that the selected compounds are tied to the specified document for provenance, and preserving the document's information for context. The result should include the unique internal identifier for the molecule (molregno), the public ChEMBL identifier for the molecule (chembl_id), the human-readable compound name (pref_name), and the title of the source document (title), maintaining the association between the activity source and the original publication for verification.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.molregno,
  d.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  d.pref_name,
  doc.title
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary d ON a.molecule_chembl_id = d.chembl_id
JOIN docs doc ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id
WHERE doc.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727678';
